solution:
# 1) Reverse a string with a stack
text = "datastructures"
stack = []
for ch in text:
    stack.append(ch)
reversed_text = "".join(reversed(stack))
print("reversed:", reversed_text)

# 2) Queue for BFS-like visitation
from collections import deque
neighbors = {"A": ["B", "C"], "B": ["D"], "C": [], "D": []}
visited = []
q = deque(["A"])
while q:
    node = q.popleft()
    visited.append(node)
    q.extend(neighbors.get(node, []))
print("bfs order:", visited)

# 3) Hash map frequency
nums = [1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3]
freq = {}
for n in nums:
    freq[n] = freq.get(n, 0) + 1
print("freq:", freq)
